products.name: Alphonso mangoes
products.description: Sun-ripened, hand-picked Alphonsos from a small coastal orchard.
products.nutrition: A source of vitamin C and vitamin A. Contains natural fruit sugars.
products.benefits: Enjoy as fresh fruit. A portion is about one small mango; fruit sugar is not the same as added sugar, but portions still count.

products.name: Heirloom tomatoes
products.description: Vine-ripened, mixed-variety tomatoes with a deep garden flavour.
products.nutrition: Provides vitamin C and lycopene. Low in calories and naturally hydrating.
products.benefits: An easy addition to meals. Contains natural sugars but very little per serving.

products.name: Rainbow carrots
products.description: A colourful mix of sweet, crunchy carrots harvested this morning.
products.nutrition: Rich in beta-carotene, which your body can convert to vitamin A.
products.benefits: A source of dietary fibre. Great raw or roasted alongside a meal.

products.name: Fresh spinach
products.description: Tender, cool-morning greens from a family-run farm.
products.nutrition: Contains folate, iron and vitamins A, C and K.
products.benefits: A source of iron; plant iron absorbs differently from iron in meat. Pair with vitamin C foods.

products.name: Organic red rice
products.description: Earthy, unpolished red rice, grown by a farmer collective.
products.nutrition: A whole grain providing carbohydrates, fibre and some plant-based protein.
products.benefits: Provides energy and takes longer to cook than white rice. Individual nutrient needs vary.

products.name: Sweet corn
products.description: Fresh, naturally sweet corn harvested at peak tenderness.
products.nutrition: Provides carbohydrates, fibre and B vitamins.
products.benefits: Naturally gluten-free whole food; contains starch, which provides energy.

crops.name: Tomato
crops.tip: Stake plants early. Avoid wetting leaves where possible to reduce fungal pressure.

crops.name: Spinach
crops.tip: Use shade cloth in warm spells. Harvest outer leaves first for a longer picking window.

crops.name: Maize
crops.tip: Plant in blocks, not a single row, to help pollination. Base timing on your local monsoon.
